name: Canton USDCx
oneLiner: Canton USDCx is a CIP-0056 dollar token on Canton Network backed by Ethereum USDC held in Circle xReserve domain 10001.
collateral: Native Ethereum USDC locked in Circle's Ethereum xReserve escrow contract (0x8888888199b2Df864bf678259607d6D5EBb4e3Ce) under Canton remote domain 10001 (0x2711). On-chain Ethereum escrow balance is collateral backing evidence rather than a clocked Canton circulating supply feed.
pegMechanism: 1:1 USDC-backed CIP-0056 token issued on Canton Network through Circle xReserve attestation rails, identified on mainnet by the composite pair InstrumentId.admin (decentralized-usdc-interchain-rep::12208115f1e168dd7e792320be9c4ca720c751a02a3053c7606e1c1cd3dad9bf60ef) and case-sensitive InstrumentId.id (USDCx), 10 decimals. Cross-chain minting and redemption require an onboarded BridgeUserAgreement rather than a public retail bridge interface, while on-ledger transfers settle peer-to-peer across CIP-0056 wallets and venues.
launchPhaseDetail: USDCx launched on Canton Network on December 4, 2025 using Circle xReserve (remote domain 10001) and CIP-0056 across 13 launch apps and participants (composite identifier InstrumentId.admin decentralized-usdc-interchain-rep::12208115f1e168dd7e792320be9c4ca720c751a02a3053c7606e1c1cd3dad9bf60ef plus InstrumentId.id USDCx; omitted from contracts[] until composite Canton instrument identities are modeled). Active admission remains blocked because Canton sub-transaction privacy prevents public verification of Daml bridge/mint authority controls, and no unauthenticated clocked Canton supply API reconciles the 2.37x gap between CoinGecko circulating supply ($3.28M) and Ethereum xReserve escrow ($7.79M as of 2026-11-27). Upon active promotion, Canton USDCx is designated for stablecoin-variant classification (variantOf usdc-circle, pure-wrapper, matching usdcx-movement) so USDC supply is not double-counted.

milestones.title: USDCx launches on Canton Network via Circle xReserve
milestones.description: Canton Network announces mainnet availability of CIP-0056 USDCx backed by Ethereum USDC in Circle xReserve domain 10001 across 13 launch ecosystem participants including Bron, Cumberland DRW, Dfns, Digital Asset, Loop, QCP, and Temple.

listingStatusReview.reason: Publicly issued on Canton via Circle xReserve (domain 10001). Active admission blocked by non-inspectable Daml bridge/mint authority under sub-transaction privacy and a 2.37x gap between CoinGecko (3.28M) and Eth xReserve escrow (7.79M) with no clocked supply API.
